top_story_headline: Threat actors weaponize Claude Code source leak, seed GitHub with trojanized repos pushing Vidar infostealer
top_story_comment: This crew rotated the same Rust dropper through 25+ brand lures since February — Claude Code is just the freshest skin on a two-month-old op. Dropped March 31, same day as the malicious Axios npm supply chain attack, so devs updating dependencies and googling the leak faced two independent infection vectors simultaneously. GhostSocks pairing with Vidar means every compromised dev machine doubles as a residential SOCKS5 proxy — those sessions with live GitHub tokens and cloud IAM creds command serious premium over raw dumps on Genesis Market.
